remarks: Looking for that perfect blend of comfort and convenience? Welcome to 19 Piave Street. Tucked away on the vibrant West Side of Stamford, this charming second-floor retreat offers an easy-living layout that makes every square inch count.  The space feels bright and inviting, especially with a fresh coat of paint that makes the whole apartment glow. You'll find a comfortable bedroom, a clean, functional bathroom, and a living area that's just waiting for your personal touch. The kitchen is ready for your first meal at home, too, featuring a suite of brand-new appliances. This unit comes with its own dedicated parking space, a true luxury in this part of town.
